description: Helper routines for the D3D11 texture format table in ANGLE's renderer, including functions to check feature levels and format support.

methods.name: OnlyFL11_1Plus
methods.description: Checks if the device supports feature level 11.1 or higher.

methods.name: OnlyFL10Plus
methods.description: Checks if the device supports feature level 10.0 or higher.

methods.name: OnlyFL9_3
methods.description: Checks if the device supports feature level 9.3.

methods.name: SupportsFormat
methods.description: Determines if a DXGI_FORMAT is supported based on device capabilities.
